newsitem.title: FINLAND: Kesko Oct sales rise 67.2 percent y/y.
newsitem.headline: Kesko Oct sales rise 67.2 percent y/y.

text.p: Wholesaler Kesko Oy said in a statement on Thursday its sales excluding value-added tax (VAT) increased 67.2 percent year-on-year in October to 3.87 billion markka.
Kesko's domestic sales excluding Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat acquired earlier this year rose 6.3 percent to 2.29 billion markka in October.
In January-October, Kesko's sales rose 32.7 percent year-on-year to 29.92 billion markka, and its domestic sales without the impact of Tuko and Kaukomarkkinat rose 1.5 percent to 21.4 billion markka.
